creationFlow.startHelp: Choose your origins and class, then review every choice before saving. Your draft stays on this device.
creationFlow.storageError: Local recovery could not be verified. Nothing here confirms a new save. Restore storage access, then check again.
creationFlow.libraryError: Your Library could not be loaded. Official sources are available; reconnect to use your saved creations.
creationFlow.unreadableDraft: This saved draft cannot be read safely. Preserve its original before starting another comparison.

creationFlow.importHelp: Compare the file, declare the rules edition and review what is preserved. Nothing is written until you confirm.

creationFlow.unavailableTarget: This character is unavailable in this account.

creationFlow.declareEdition: Which rules edition does this character use?
creationFlow.preservedUnresolved: Preserved in the copy or exact recovery original. Mechanical reconciliation remains unresolved.

creationFlow.reviewPreserved: Your proposed review below is preserved when refreshing the comparison.
creationFlow.archiveOnly: This field is retained only in the exact original archive.
